Model & evidence

Optimised for the dangerous end of the distribution.

The full Temporal Fusion Transformer is trained with high-temperature weighting. The trade-off is explicit: better recovery of high-heat events and station-day peaks at the cost of some all-weather average accuracy.

01

Historical context

Seven days of station history provide the model with recent heat and weather dynamics before each 24-hour forecast.

02

High-heat weighting

Training places extra emphasis on hotter observations so dangerous events are not overwhelmed by routine weather.

03

Live serving

The backend rebuilds 168 hours of station history and publishes all 24 horizons in one V4 inference pass.

Completed B1 implementation

Six integrated capabilities, connected end to end.

The live backend reads temperature, humidity and rainfall, reconstructs V4 inputs, and refreshes the station and planning-area views automatically.

01 · Implemented

Live station heat index

Latest temperature and relative-humidity readings are paired into a current heat index across the station network.

02 · Implemented

Live 24h heat forecast

V4 produces station forecasts for hours 1–24 from a rolling 168-hour history.

03 · Implemented

Planning-area Heat Risk Score

A separately trained classifier combines forecast heat, official 2026 age structure and mapped eldercare access across 55 planning areas.

04 · Implemented

Tiered recommendations

Low, Medium and High classes drive a ranked review queue and response prompts.

05 · Implemented

Three real-time streams

Air temperature, relative humidity and rainfall feed the history-only live model service.

06 · Implemented

Cooling intervention simulator

High-risk areas can be tested with added cooling points and a green-corridor shade proxy.

Responsible use & data lineage

Evidence, provenance and human review built in.

Research planning forecast

The live output turns public station data into a planning forecast while official public guidance remains with Singapore's responsible agencies.

Demographics are contextual

Planning-area and subzone age structure uses official 2026 statistics. HDB-building population values are modelled estimates and are labelled accordingly.

Mapped support access

MOH eldercare points provide a consistent indicator of nearby community support for planning review.

Human review stays in the loop

Risk tiers prioritise inspection and support decisions alongside official public guidance.
